notes: Partition verified: all 26 source and 30 target IDs used exactly once; `אֵת` (s007) and the bracketed article of `בַּשָּׁמַיִם` (s025) are the only unrepresented units, the latter because the ASV writes a bare *heaven*.
The `בַּ` of `בַּשָּׁמַיִם` holds *up to* whole, headed on *up* by rule 24's `מִן` → *out of* precedent; attaching *up* to *fortified* was the competing reading and is named in the unit's note.
The article of `הַיּוֹם` takes the written *this* under rule 41, no demonstrative pronoun standing in the phrase to claim it.
